vectors.guidance_rule: Only HR may add a new employee
rules_involved: deny["Only HR department users may add a new employee"]
vectors.reason: Policy checks 'not "HR" in subject.department' but subject.department could be null/undefined
vectors.exploit_strategy: Send add_employee request with subject.department omitted or null

vectors.guidance_rule: When an employee's salary is set or updated, it must be a positive amount (greater than zero)
rules_involved: deny["Salary must be greater than zero"]
vectors.reason: Policy uses numeric comparison 'args.salary <= 0' without type check, allowing string bypass
vectors.exploit_strategy: Send add_employee with salary as string '0' or negative string '-1'

vectors.guidance_rule: A new or updated employee's work email must use their organization's corporate domain
rules_involved: deny["Email domain does not match the corporate domain for the provided organization"]
vectors.reason: Policy uses endswith() check which can be bypassed with malformed email containing the domain as substring
vectors.exploit_strategy: Send add_employee with email like 'user@evil.com@ibm.com' or 'user@ibm.com.evil.com'
